methodology.base: Same as V18+ no-limit: V18 source candidates, avoid_score4 prior-only filter, V17 runner exit, V18 fee/tax assumptions, and +0.10% adverse slippage each side.
methodology.changed_only: Entry pool is filtered by original signal score bucket/combinations. No finite capital, no max positions, no max-new-per-day, and no duplicate-stock capacity filter are applied.
methodology.splits: Same 10 random stock-code 60/20/20 seeds used by the plus random split report. Same stock cannot appear in more than one split inside a run.
methodology.warning: This challenges the original score calculation. Results with tiny test samples should not be treated as robust even if averages look high.
